quote: Paul Kelly posed the Reconstruction Conjecture in his Ph.D. dissertation at the University of Wisconsin–Madison in 1942, supervised by Stanislaw Ulam
note: Wikipedia attributes the conjecture to 'Kelly and Ulam' but does not specify a year in the article. The earliest documented formulation is Kelly's 1942 Ph.D. dissertation. Kelly's 1957 paper 'A congruence theorem for trees' proved the conjecture for trees but did not state the conjecture itself. Ulam later publicized it in 'A Collection of Mathematical Problems' (1960).
